title: Delhi High Court allows Sonam Wangchuk to be shifted to Medanta Hospital
description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday allowed activist Sonam Wangchuk, who is on hunger strike in solidarity with the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) student protest, to be shifted from Safdarjung hospital to Medanta hospital [Gitanjali Angmo v. Union of India].A Bench of Chief Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Justice Tejas Karia passed the order after Wanghcuk's wife Gitanjali Angmo (appellant) approached the Court saying he was being held at Safdarjung hospital against his will and the Delhi Police
